items.title: Farm Journal Expands Livestock Podcast Network with Two New Shows
items.author: Farm Journal
items.content:
– Today, Farm Journal, U.S. agriculture’s leading business information and data insights company, is expanding its livestock podcast network with the launch of two new shows designed to bring deeper industry conversations to beef and dairy audiences.

, hosted by Drovers Editorial Director Angie Denton, and The MILK Business Podcast, hosted by Dairy Editorial Director Karen Bohnert, extend two of Farm Journal’s established livestock brands into an increasingly important on-demand format. These launches strengthen a growing podcast portfolio built to connect producers and industry professionals with trusted voices, practical insight and the issues shaping animal agriculture.

“Livestock producers are navigating a rapidly changing business environment, and they want credible information delivered in ways that fit how they work and consume content,” said Clinton Griffiths, Executive Producer for Farm Journal. “These new podcasts give us another opportunity to bring the trusted voices behind Drovers and MILK Business closer to their audiences while creating more space for the conversations that matter most to their businesses.”The MILK Business Podcast will officially launch during World Dairy Expo, Sept. 29-Oct. 2. Hosted by Bohnert, the show will go beyond the headlines to explore the business of dairy through conversations about management, markets, innovation, people and the strategies driving progressive dairy operations.

launches in late October, bringing the perspective and authority of the Drovers brand to an audio and video format. Denton will sit down with cattle producers, industry leaders and experts for candid conversations about the people, pressures, opportunities and decisions shaping the beef business.

The two launches build on Farm Journal’s growing presence in livestock podcasting. They join The Bovine Veterinarian Podcast, hosted by Andrea Bedford, and , hosted by Jennifer Shike, creating a stronger lineup of dedicated programming across beef, dairy, swine and animal health.

With these additions, Farm Journal’s broader podcast network now includes 12 shows spanning key sectors and interests across agriculture. The expanded lineup reflects a continued investment in delivering specialized, trusted agricultural content across the platforms audiences use most, including print, digital, broadcast, streaming, social, events and podcasts.

and The MILK Business Podcast will be available on Farm Journal TV and major podcast platforms, including Apple Podcasts, Spotify and iHeartRadio.

Farm Journal is the nation’s leading business information and media company serving the agricultural market. The company serves the row crop, livestock, produce and retail sectors through branded websites, eNewsletters and phone apps; business magazines; live events including conferences and tradeshows; nationally broadcast television and radio programs; and an array of data-driven, paid information products. Farm Journal owns the online equipment marketplace, Machinery Pete LLC. Trust In Food is a Farm Journal initiative dedicated to accelerating the adoption of conservation practices and regenerative agriculture in ways that work for producers and enhance connection to consumers. In 2010, the company established the non-profit, public charity, Farm Journal Foundation, dedicated to sustaining agriculture’s ability to meet the vital needs of a growing population through education and empowerment.
